install:
set -euo pipefail
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config ca-certificates curl
if ! command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain stable --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy
else
  rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy
  rustup default stable
fi
CARGO_BIN="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin"
if [ ! -x "$CARGO_BIN/cargo" ] && [ -x /usr/local/cargo/bin/cargo ]; then CARGO_BIN=/usr/local/cargo/bin; fi
for b in cargo rustc rustup rustfmt cargo-fmt cargo-clippy; do
  if [ -x "$CARGO_BIN/$b" ]; then sudo ln -sfn "$CARGO_BIN/$b" "/usr/local/bin/$b"; fi
done
